description: Records why the q_cross(n) trend question is convention-C-only. The probe straddled two conventions inside one computation: _D_wenzl / U_STAR / Q_STAR and the level-integer ladder were convention C hardcoded in the file, while level_r() read the corpus's convention-D _wenzl_constants. Under D, Q^r = Q^2 exactly, so the level is the constant 2, there is no pole (the live function is regular at C's q*), no real-level branch and no ladder; and the l(lam) >= 3 stratum is a structural zero, so the crossings previously reported were round-off, shown by their n-independence. BG-1, the dual-Cauchy normaliser identity, is convention-independent and is re-verified. Supersedes the 2026-08-09 C-frame witness.

convention_c_record.note: Correct for convention C. Under D `q0_on_real_level_branch` asserts a structure that does not exist -- there is no pole, so no branch to be on or off. The three False results remain False under D but for an entirely different reason: the object is identically zero, so there are no crossings at all. Green, but vacuous. Do not read these as live.

caveats: RETIRED AS A LIVE PROBE. This witness no longer reports a q_cross trend. Under convention D the l(lam) >= 3 stratum is a structural zero, so G_n and F_K vanish identically there and the crossings the previous sweep reported were round-off sign flips -- demonstrated by their being IDENTICAL across n, which an n-dependent object cannot be.

The superseded witness asserted `q0_on_real_level_branch: True`. Under D there is no pole, hence no branch to be on or off, so that assertion named a structure that does not exist. Its three False results stay False under D but for a different reason -- no crossings at all, rather than an unstructured sequence of them. Green, but vacuous.

Scope-(a), about this probe. The Q^r = u^3/D(u) family is a legitimate object and is NOT refuted; the finding is that this file was not computing it -- its branch geometry was convention C hardcoded while its level function read convention D from the corpus. Re-pinning to C and registering an off-canon comparison was the alternative disposition, not taken: C is excised by owner ruling (2026-08-15) and the question concerns a stratum carrying no weight in the canonical convention.
